import json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sha = "a" * 40
d = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
def run_(name, workflow="CI", status="completed", conclusion="success", head=sha):
    return {"databaseId": 1, "name": name, "workflowName": workflow, "status": status, "conclusion": conclusion, "headSha": head}
cases = {
    "green": ([run_("ubuntu"), run_("macos")], 0, "pass", []),
    "red": ([run_("ubuntu"), run_("macos", conclusion="failure")], 1, "fail", ["macos"]),
    "pending": ([run_("ubuntu", status="in_progress", conclusion="")], 1, "fail", ["ubuntu"]),
    "other": ([run_("ubuntu", head="b" * 40)], 1, "fail", []),
    "empty": ([], 1, "fail", []),
}
for name, (runs, code, result, failing) in cases.items():
    f = d / (name + ".json"); f.write_text(json.dumps(runs))
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/ci_status.py", "--commit", sha, "--runs-json", str(f)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert r.returncode == code, (name, r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
    last = json.loads(r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
    assert last == {"commit": sha, "result": result, "failing": failing}, (name, last)
(d / "bad.json").write_text("{}")
for argv in (["--commit", sha, "--runs-json", str(d / "bad.json")], ["--commit", "xyz", "--runs-json", str(d / "green.json")], ["--commit", sha, "--runs-json", str(d / "missing.json")]):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/ci_status.py", *argv], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert r.returncode == 2, (argv, r.returncode)
own = json.load(open("harness-manifest.json", encoding="utf-8"))["ownership"]
assert all("scripts/ci_status.py" in own[k] for k in ("install_payload_paths", "update_paths")), "manifest"
assert "scripts/ci_status.py --commit" in open("docs/missions/ORCHESTRATION.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
print("ok")
